A feature release of **cob-portal-mcp**: ask Claude for portal changes, review them, approve them in the portal.

## Added

- Scopes `changes:read` and `changes:draft`.
- Read tools: `list_change_areas`, `read_settings`, `read_job_roles`, `read_people`, `read_rounds`, `read_leave_types`,
  `read_holidays`, `read_shifts`, `read_checkin_places`, `read_templates_full`.
- Change set tools: `draft_changes`, `get_change_set`, `list_change_sets`, `withdraw_change_set`.
- Prompt `change_portal`.

Nothing changes until a person approves the set on Changes to review in the portal. No tool approves, applies or undoes.

## Install

```bash
npx -y cob-portal-mcp@0.4.0
```

Full history: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/callobuzz/cob-portal-mcp/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
